question: Where was the National Agriculture-Renewable Energy Conference 2025 held?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan participates in ‘National Agro-RE Summit 2025’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Event:** National Agriculture–Renewable Energy Conference 2025

 
 
• 
 
**Location:** **New Delhi**

 
 
• 
 
**Organised by:** **National Solar Energy Federation of India (NSEFI)**

 
 
• 
 
**Attended by:** **Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan**

 
 
• 
 
**Purpose:** To promote **integration of renewable energy** in the agriculture sector

 
 
• 
 
**Released:** **NSEFI’s report and annual reference book** on agriculture & renewable energy

 
 
• 
 
**6 Key Focus Areas for Farmer Prosperity:**

 
 
• 
 
**Increase production**

 
 
• 
 
**Reduce cost of production**

 
 
• 
 
**Ensure fair prices**

 
 
• 
 
**Provide compensation for losses**

 
 
• 
 
**Encourage diversification**

 
 
• 
 
**Promote balanced fertilizer use**
